addr.description: Local IPv4 address to bind the server to.

port.description: UDP listening port for the PQConnect server.

keydir.description: Directory containing the long-term cryptographic keys.

keyport.description: UDP listening port for the key server component.

mask.description: Netmask for the private network in CIDR format (8-24).

interface_name.description: Name of the network interface created/used by PQConnect.

host_ip.description: IP address where decrypted traffic should be delivered (required for VMs).
